answer: Each challenge is derived with a domain-separated hash from a participant’s commitment and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, so its unpredictable inputs—such as “gale,” “canyon,” and “garden”—are unavailable for advance computation. Commit-reveal binds responses to the assigned round; scoring verified, costly work makes spawning identities alone unprofitable. The beacon limits offline farming, though it does not by itself prevent Sybil identities.
